openwrt_git.betreff: ath79: Add support for Plasma Cloud PA300E
openwrt_git.text: Qualcomm/Atheros QCA9533 v2; 650/600/217 MHz (CPU/DDR/AHB); 64 MB of RAM; 16 MB of SPI NOR flash (mx25l12805d) - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image; 2x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet; 2T2R 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; multi-color LED (controlled via red/green/blue GPIOs); 1x GPIO-button (reset); external h/w watchdog (enabled by default); TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX); 2x fast ethernet - eth0: Label: Ethernet 1, 24V passive POE (mode B), used as WAN interface - eth1: Label: Ethernet 2, 802.3af POE, builtin switch port 2, used as LAN interface; 12-24V 1A DC; external antennas. Flashing instructions: The tool ap51-flash (https://github.com/ap51-flash/ap51-flash) should be used to transfer the factory image to the u-boot when the device boots up.

openwrt_dts.leds: status_red gpio 0, status_green gpio 2 (boot/failsafe/running/upgrade), status_blue gpio 3
openwrt_dts.watchdog: linux,wdt-gpio gpio 12, hw_algo toggle, hw_margin_ms 60000 (real 300 s), always-running; SoC-wdt disabled
openwrt_dts.flash: jedec,spi-nor 25 MHz; Partitionen u-boot 0x0-0x40000 (ro), u-boot-env 0x40000 (256k), custom 0x80000 (0x140000, ro), inactive 0x1c0000 (7 MB), inactive2 0x8c0000 (7 MB), ART 0xfc0000 (256k, ro); Partitionen vom Bootloader uebergeben
openwrt_dts.mac: label-mac-device eth0; eth0 = ART+0, eth1 = ART+1, wmac = ART+2; Kalibrierung ART 0x1000 (0x440)
openwrt_dts.ethernet: eth0 phy-handle swphy4; eth1 als qca9530-eth (Reihenfolge wie ar71xx)

openwrt_image_mk.Device/plasmacloud_pa300-common: SOC qca9533; DEVICE_VENDOR Plasma Cloud; DEVICE_PACKAGES uboot-envtools; IMAGE_SIZE 7168k; IMAGES += factory.bin; KERNEL kernel-bin | append-dtb | lzma | uImage lzma | pad-to $$(BLOCKSIZE); IMAGE/factory.bin append-rootfs | pad-rootfs | openmesh-image ce_type=PA300; IMAGE/sysupgrade.bin append-rootfs | pad-rootfs | sysupgrade-tar rootfs=$$$$@ | append-metadata

hersteller_seite.Kategorien: Cloud Managed WiFi Access Points, WiFi 5 Access Points
hersteller_seite.Key features: 2.4 GHz 802.11n WiFi, two external antennas; Zero config, plug-and-play networking; Free cloud-based web console for complete management; Water and dust resistant with an IP55 rating; Universal installation kit included
hersteller_seite.Beschreibung: Plasma Cloud's low cost solution providing single band dual stream 2.4GHz 802.11n WiFi in a weather resistant housing. Your best choice if the budget is a concern or for large WiFi sensor deployments with custom antennas.
hersteller_seite.Ethernet Ports: The 2 provided Ethernet ports allow for maximum flexibility: one port can be used as wired uplink while the other port serves as LAN access for other wired devices. Each Ethernet port comes a smart uplink detection ...
hersteller_seite.Mounting Options: wall, ceiling grid, pole, outdoors - installer kit included with every Access Point
hersteller_seite.Indoor/Outdoor Rating: CE marked for indoor/outdoor use, IP55
hersteller_seite.Dokumente: Datasheet - PA300E Access Point v1.2; Quick Start Guide - PA300E Access Point v1.3

hersteller_datenblatt.Titel: PA300E Single-band Access Point, Two external antennas, 100% outdoor ready, Cloud managed
hersteller_datenblatt.Housing: IP55 Certified Outdoor Housing, Water Resistance; Water resistant design with sealed top and bottom enclosures and water resistant cable bay allows versatile installation environment including shaded garden, under eaves, outdoor shed, or veranda
hersteller_datenblatt.Mounting options: Wall Mount, Pole Mount, T-rail Mount, Junction Plate
hersteller_datenblatt.Indoor / Outdoor Rating: CE marked for indoor / outdoor use, IP55
hersteller_datenblatt.RF Performance 2.4 GHz TX: 802.11b 1-11 Mbps 26 dBm; 802.11g 6-48 Mbps 26 dBm, 54 Mbps 24 dBm; HT20/HT40 MCS0-3 26 dBm, MCS4-6 25 dBm, MCS7 24 dBm
hersteller_datenblatt.RF Performance 2.4 GHz RX: 11b 1 Mbps -85 dBm, 11 Mbps -82 dBm; 11g 6 Mbps -85 dBm, 54 Mbps -70 dBm; HT20 MCS0 -85 dBm, MCS7 -68 dBm; HT40 MCS0 -82 dBm, MCS7 -65 dBm
hersteller_datenblatt.Radiation patterns: fuer die beiliegenden Antennen, nur als Grafik

hersteller_qsg.Package contents: 1. Access Point; 2. Two antennas and rings (PA300E only); 3. Mounting options (ceiling, wall, pole, T-rail); 4. Open cable housing lid; 5. Closed cable housing lid; 6. Screws and screw plugs for various surfaces; 7. Cable ties
hersteller_qsg.Physical installation: designed to be installed virtually anywhere and can operate between 0°C ~ 40°C; mounting options for ceilings, walls, poles and T-rails
hersteller_qsg.Power: can be powered by (from left to right): 1. a 12-24V/1A DC power adapter 2. a 24V/1A passive PoE injector 3. a 48-54V/0.5A PoE injector (802.3af/at)

hersteller_blog.Titel: Meet the PA300E, the Access Point you've been waiting for!
hersteller_blog.Text: It's none other than a PA300 for people who want additional flexibility. The PA300E comes with 2 external antennas that can be substituted with those of your liking thanks to RP-SMA connectors; all of this while maintaining the same slim and minimal housing format as its twin PA300. This means that its case is also weatherproof and does not require additional outdoor housing! ... Use directional antennas for point-to-point backhaul links, long-range shots ... sector antennas ...

offene_faeden.grund: Datenblatt nennt FCC- und IC-Zertifizierung, die FCC-ID steht aber in keiner gefundenen Quelle (ToH '¿', Herstellerseite, QSG, Datenblatt); fccid.io-Suche gesperrt, Grantee WT8 (Open Mesh/Datto) enthält kein Plasma-Cloud-Gerät. Typenschildfoto oder ISED-REL-Suche (Plasma Cloud) nötig

Widerspruch: Commit nennt Ethernet 1 = 24 V passiv (Mode B, WAN) und Ethernet 2 = 802.3af; Gehäusebeschriftung auf dem Herstellerfoto (PA300/PA300E) sagt '48-54V PoE Ethernet 1' und '24V PoE Ethernet 2'. Am Gerät prüfen
DC-Buchse 12-24 V/1 A belegt, Hohlstecker-Maß in keiner Quelle
Baudrate/Pegel nicht angegeben ('¿'); Commit nennt nur Pinfolge VCC, GND, TX, RX, nicht ob Stiftleiste bestückt
Keine Hardware-Versionen bekannt (ToH 'Versions' leer); Typenschild nicht gesehen
Kein Geizhals-Eintrag im Webarchiv, keine EAN/ASIN in Hersteller-Dokumenten; ggf. Händlerseiten (Distributoren unter plasma-cloud.com 'Where to Buy') prüfen
Kein Forumsthread in ToH verlinkt; Suche nicht ausgeführt (search.json gedrosselt)

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata (Rev. 2026-03-08), OpenWrt-Commit 17e5920 (+ PA300 5fc28ef, 57e6f3a), DTS/dtsi, generic.mk, 02_network, Gluon-Target/Commit/platform.lua, ap51-flash-Doku, Herstellerseite (live und Archiv 2019), Datenblatt v1.2, QSG v1.3, Produktfotos (Anschlussfach, Unterseite), Blog 2019-07-22 ausgewertet. Keine Werkstatt-Protokolle, keine OpenWrt-Wiki-Geräteseite, keine DeviWiki/WikiDevi-Seite. Widersprüche: SoC QCA9533 v2 (OpenWrt) vs. QCA9531 (Hersteller); PoE-Art je Port (Commit vs. Gehäusebeschriftung). FCC-ID, DC-Buchsenmaß, serielle Baudrate, Handelsdaten offen. web.archive.org CDX einmal 503 (Temporarily Offline), danach wieder erreichbar.
